The /backtests/export/insights API provides a response in the following format:

200 Success

BacktestInsightExportRow Model - Insight row of a backtest export.
id string
example: 4e9e6b461ef04756b6e6450b54953dea
Id of the insight.
groupId string
Id of the insight group.
sourceModel string
example: d1e4e8e4-a645-492c-bfb9-0006971e22b9
Id of the Alpha model that emitted the insight.
generatedTime integer
example: 1705093200
Unix time when the algorithm emitted the insight.
createdTime integer
example: 1705093200
Unix time when the insight was created.
closeTime integer
example: 1705438800
Unix time when the insight expires.
symbol string
example: SPY R735QTJ8XC9X
Id of the Symbol.
ticker string
example: SPY
Ticker of the Symbol.
type string Enum
Type of the insight. Options : ['price', 'volatility']
reference number
example: 461.57615586
Price of the Symbol when the algorithm emitted the insight.
referenceValueFinal number
Final reference value that scores the insight.
direction string Enum
Direction of the insight. Options : ['down', 'flat', 'up']
period integer
example: 86400
Period of the insight in seconds.
magnitude number
Predicted percent change of the insight type (price or volatility).
confidence number
Confidence of the insight.
weight number
Portfolio weight of the insight.
scoreIsFinal boolean
True if the scores are final.
scoreMagnitude string
example: 0
Magnitude score of the insight, as a decimal string.
scoreDirection string
example: 0
Direction score of the insight, as a decimal string.
estimatedValue string
example: 0
Estimated value of the insight in the account currency, as a decimal string.
tag string
Tag of the insight.
Example 
[
  {
    "id": "4e9e6b461ef04756b6e6450b54953dea",
    "groupId": "string",
    "sourceModel": "d1e4e8e4-a645-492c-bfb9-0006971e22b9",
    "generatedTime": 1705093200,
    "createdTime": 1705093200,
    "closeTime": 1705438800,
    "symbol": "SPY R735QTJ8XC9X",
    "ticker": "SPY",
    "type": "price",
    "reference": 461.57615586,
    "referenceValueFinal": 0,
    "direction": "down",
    "period": 86400,
    "magnitude": 0,
    "confidence": 0,
    "weight": 0,
    "scoreIsFinal": true,
    "scoreMagnitude": "0",
    "scoreDirection": "0",
    "estimatedValue": "0",
    "tag": "string"
  }
]

401 Authentication Error

UnauthorizedError Model - Unauthorized response from the API. Key is missing, invalid, or timestamp is too old for hash.
www_authenticate string
Header
